The '''Wakeelmui system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Wakeelmui]]. A [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] construction facility that produced [[L-s7.2 laser cannon/Legends|L-s7.2 laser cannons]] was located in the system.
